{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but objected that coinbase fees are lost with mempool templates and noted missing test coverage"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3961009614",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "rebuilding the coinbase reward strictly with the block subsidy drops transaction fees when a template contains mempool transactions",
      "quote": "This is an assignment rather than an adjustment, so the template's fees go with it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author asserted template is coinbase-only and disabled mempool in MinerTestingSetup::Block()",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4100107357"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4100107357",
      "status_by_quote": "Sure, added `.use_mempool = false` to `MinerTestingSetup::Block()` and asserted the shared helper receives a coinbase-only block."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3961009618",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "lack of test coverage for target recalculation and coinbase adjustments in arbitrary parent rebuilding",
      "quote": "Removing the target, subsidy or padding line here leaves blockfilter_index_tests and baseindex_tests green, so nothing on that side covers what the branch changes.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added tests covering the target recalculation and coinbase adjustments",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4100145138"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4100145138",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks! I added similar tests, with the coinbase cases combined into one fork test."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5145514356",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Built each commit and ran the unit tests, with a before and after of both cases against master.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "jeanpablojp to review the fixes and rebase",
      "id": "r:5312175455"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "l0rinc replied to and implemented fixes for both of jeanpablojp's objections, pushing a rebase with tests and coinbase-only enforcement."
}
